found.quote: Never be afraid to ask your tutor if you aren’t clear.
Your work should always authentically represent your capabilities.
Some indicators wouldn’t appear in an assessment written by a human. Wherever the use of generative AI is suspected, we will investigate this fully in line with our Academic Misconduct Policy.
